verdicts.reason: Both fail in the same ways. The brick and crane photos have shrunk to tiny thumbnails, so the original's key imagery is effectively gone. The pink brush underline has come away from the headline, been duplicated and been stretched into stray bars. The headline and body copy are tiny on a mostly empty white column with large dead areas. Their layouts are nearly the same: A places the text block slightly higher and B slightly lower, but neither is better.
